name: rosetta-input-loop
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line

let lines mut = 0

while let line = read_line() do
    lines = lines + 1

    write_line("{lines}: {line}")
od

write_line("the stream ran out after {lines} lines")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.Std.read_line

let lines mut = 0

while let line = read_line() do
    lines = lines + 1

    write_line("{lines}: {line}")
od

write_line("the stream ran out after {lines} lines")
output:
1: the first line
2: the second line
3: the third line
the stream ran out after 3 lines
